title: Basic shell commands
subtitle: man, navigation, files, env, and pagers — flip for meaning and flags

cards.meaning: Full manual page for a command (Unix default help)
cards.example: man man; man 1 ls; man 5 passwd
cards.notes: Sections: 1 user cmds, 5 file formats, 8 admin. Inside: j/k, /pattern, q like less.
-k = keyword (many hits). man -f ls = one-line whatis.

cards.meaning: Long+all / long+human sizes / newest first / largest first + human
cards.notes: -a shows dotfiles. -S is Size (capital); -s is a different flag. Ops almost always wants -la.

cards.meaning: Print cwd / previous dir / home / parent
cards.notes: Bare cd goes $HOME. cd - also prints the path it landed on. / is filesystem root.

cards.meaning: Create empty file or update timestamp / set date from a string
cards.notes: No file → create empty. File exists → poke its time.

cards.meaning: Make parents as needed; no error if they already exist
cards.notes: Brace expansion test{1..3} → test1 test2 test3. -m MODE sets permissions.

cards.meaning: Copy directory tree / recursive and preserve mode, owner, timestamps
cards.notes: File copy = cp src dest. Directory needs -r/-R. -p = --preserve=mode,ownership,timestamps.

cards.meaning: Move or rename / backup overwritten dest with suffix / move only if newer or missing
cards.notes: Rename is a move in the same parent. -i prompts before overwrite.

cards.meaning: Concatenate files into one (or print a single file)
cards.notes: Memory hook: cat a b > c glues a then b into c. cat file just prints.

cards.meaning: Remove empty directory only / recursive force verbose delete
cards.notes: rm -rf ignores missing and never prompts — think before / or $HOME. shred overwrites for harder recovery.

cards.meaning: Print exported environment (all or named) / dump env or run a command in a custom env
cards.notes: env VAR=tmp ./script sets VAR for the child only — current shell unchanged.

cards.meaning: Make a variable visible to children / delete shell and environment variable
cards.notes: export is how ~/.bash_profile values reach vim, python, etc. set | less dumps everything.

cards.meaning: Pager both ways (prefer) / page forward only (old/small systems)
cards.notes: less exists because more could not scroll back. /pattern ?pattern n N like Vim. q quits.

cards.meaning: First 10 lines / first K lines / all but the last K lines
cards.notes: Default is 10. Negative -n means drop the last K lines.

cards.meaning: Last 10 lines / last K / from line K to end / follow growing file
cards.notes: tail -f is the live-log tool; Ctrl-C to stop. Memory hook: head = top, tail = bottom.

cards.meaning: GNU info pages — often longer and hyperlinked
cards.notes: DevOps default: try man first, then man -k if you forgot the name, info for GNU depth.
